_meta.feast: The Beheading of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist John
_meta._note: OCA does not publish a Matins DOCX for this feast. Matins from St-Sergius Emenaion (yy/archaic register). Two canons: Canon I by John the Monk in Tone VIII (8 troparia); Canon II by Andrew of Crete in same Tone (6 troparia). Strict fast day — faithful abstain from meat, cheese, eggs, fish. The Beatitudes troparia at Liturgy are drawn from canon Ode III/VI per the Sergius rubric.

troparion.text:
The memory of the just is celebrated with hymns of praise
but the Lord's testimony is enough for thee, O Forerunner,
for thou wast shown to be more wonderful than the Prophets
since thou wast granted to baptize in the running waters Him Whom thou didst proclaim.
Then having endured great suffering for the Truth,
Thou didst rejoice to bring, even to those in Hades
the good tidings that God had appeared in the flesh
taking away the sin of the world//
and granting us great mercy.
troparion.label: Troparion of the holy forerunner

kontakion.text:
The glorious beheading of the forerunner
was part of God's dispensation,
that he might proclaim to those in Hades
the coming of the Savior.
Let Herodias, who demanded the iniquitous murder, therefore lament;
for she loved not the law of God nor the age of life,//
but rather this false and transitory one.
kontakion.label: Kontakion of the holy forerunner

sedalion.text:
Assembling, O ye faithful, let us praise together the mediator between the law and grace;
for he preached repentance to us
and, having boldly and publicly denounced Herod, was beheaded.
And dwelling now with the angels, he entreateth Christ, that our souls be saved.
sedalion.label: Sessional Hymn (after Kathisma 1)

glory.text:
Celebrating thy radiant memory today, we beseech thee, O forerunner:
earnestly entreat the Savior and Lord, that He grant forgiveness of sins unto all.

bothNow.text:
O ye faithful, let us bless the Theotokos,
our helper, the fervent aid of those amid misfortune,//
by whom we have been delivered from foreign bondage.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

sedalion.text:
In hymns let us praise John the forerunner, the baptizer of Christ,
the prophet who was revealed unto us in his mother's womb,
the luminary who manifestly issued forth unto the world from a barren woman,
the victorious spiritual athlete;
for he prayeth to the Lord, that our souls find mercy.
sedalion.label: Sessional Hymn (after Kathisma 2)

glory.text:
Now hath the baptizer of the Savior, the adornment of the desert and seal of the prophets,
appeared unto us, and maketh glad the thoughts of the faithful with understanding.
Wherefore, the forerunner of Christ hath been shown forth, the true witness to His coming.
Let us therefore cry out together unto John with spiritual hymns:
O prophet, preacher of the truth, pray thou that we be saved.

bothNow.text:
All the choirs of Angels were struck with wonder, O Pure Virgin,
at the awesome mystery of thy conception.
How can the One who doth hold all things in place with only a nod,
now be held in Thine arms as a man?
How can the Eternal accept a beginning?
How can the One who nourishes everything that hath breath by His ineffable goodness,
be suckled at thy breast?
And upon seeing these things, with hymns they glorify thee//
as truly the Mother of God.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

magnification.refrain:
We magnify thee, O John, thou baptizer of the Savior,
and we all honor the severing of thy precious head.
verses: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord. In His commandments shall he greatly delight.
Glory… Both now… Alleluia… Glory to thee, O God!

sessionalHymns.text:
Having denounced Herod for the iniquity of Herodias, O ye faithful,
the forerunner, baptizer and angel of the Redeemer of all dieth, beheaded,
that he might proclaim with boldness to those in Hades the glad tidings
that God would descend thereto, to make death captive.
sessionalHymns.label: Sessional Hymn after the Polyeleios
sessionalHymns.melody: Of the piping of the shepherds

bothNow.text:
The Word of the Father descended to earth,
and the radiant angel said to the Theotokos:
"Rejoice, O blessed one who alone hast preserved the bridal chamber,
do thou accept the conception of the pre-eternal God and Lord,
that He might, as God, save the human race from deception."
bothNow.label: Theotokion

prokeimenon.refrain:
Precious in the sight of the Lord
is the death of His saints.
prokeimenon.verse: What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto me?

gospel._note: Herod the tetrarch hearing of Jesus; the death of John.

postGospelSticheron.text:
The disciple of the most evil devil danced,
and received thy head as her reward, O forerunner.
O feast full of blood!
Better would it have been not to have sworn thine oath, O iniquitous Herod, grandson of lies!
For even though thou didst make thy vow, it was not well sworn.
Better would it have been to be proved false,
than to cut off the head of the forerunner, who spake the truth.
Yet, honoring the Baptist as the greatest born of women,//
we call him blessed, as is meet.
postGospelSticheron.label: Sticheron after Psalm 50

_authors.first: John the Monk (Canon I, Tone VIII, 8 troparia)
_authors.second: Andrew of Crete (Canon II, Tone VIII, 6 troparia)

canon._canonNote: Two canons of the holy forerunner. Both in Tone VIII. Katavasiae are those of the Cross.

ode1.irmos:
Having passed through the water as upon dry land,
and having escaped the malice of the Egyptians,
the Israelites cried aloud:
Unto our God and Redeemer let us sing.
ode1.irmos2:
Unto Him Who overthrew the tyranny of Pharaoh in the sea
and led Israel over dry land,
let us chant unto Christ our God,
for He hath been glorified throughout the ages.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Let us hymn the sacred forerunner, the prophet who appeared from the womb of a barren woman
unto Him Who ineffably is borne in the Virgin's womb.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Having transcended the boundaries of nature,
thou didst preserve the laws of righteousness,
denouncing an iniquitous union, undaunted by the king's cruelty.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Nurtured by the law as with milk,
thou didst oppose the vile adultery,
sealing the legislation of lawful union like a seal of the law.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: The ranks of angels and mortals praise thee unceasingly, O Mother unwedded;
for thou didst bear the Creator in thine arms as a babe.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The beauteous lamb of the wilderness, the fruit of Zachariah,
and the offshoot which Elizabeth bore beyond hope,
commandeth the faithful to celebrate his honored memory beforehand.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O birthday full of blood! O abominable feast!
For Herod mingled drunkenness with slaying,
and his table was full of vile murder.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O ye faithful, let us hymn the Baptist who denounced iniquitous Herod
and endured beheading, slain for his zeal for God.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Thou hast given birth to the infinite Word of God,
Who made His abode within thee, O pure Birthgiver of God,
and ineffably became incarnate from thee twofold in nature, as thine only Son.

ode1.katavasia:
Inscribing the invincible weapon of the Cross upon the waters,
Moses marked a straight line before him with his staff and divided the Red Sea,
opening a path for Israel who went over dry-shod.
Then he marked a second line across the waters and united them in one,
overwhelming the chariots of Pharaoh.
Therefore let us sing to Christ our God, for He hath been glorified.

ode3.irmos:
O Lord, Creator of the vault of Heaven and Builder of the Church,
do Thou strengthen me in Thy love, O Summit of desire,
O Support of the faithful, O only Lover of mankind.
ode3.irmos2:
There is none as holy as the Lord, and none as righteous as our God,
Whom the whole of creation doth hymn:
There is none more righteous than Thee, O Lord.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
As mediator standing between the old and the new covenant of the Gospel preaching,
thou didst denounce the iniquitous union of the tyrant,
and, rejoicing, didst accept a glorious death.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Instructed beforehand by her iniquitous mother,
the girl said unto Herod, who was befuddled with drunkenness:
"Give me the head of John on a platter, that I may present to my mother the gift she desireth!"

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The shameless tyrant, unable to endure the reproof of thy God-bearing tongue, O glorious prophet,
gave thy precious martyr's head to the girl as a reward for her dancing.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Having made thy bodily abode within the Virgin, O Lord,
Thou didst appear unto mankind, in that it was fitting that they behold Thee.
Her didst Thou show to be the true Theotokos and the help of the faithful,
O thou only Lover of mankind.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Having first pointed to the Lamb with his finger,
he next denounced Herod with his tongue,
and, lastly, poureth forth miracles upon us through his head, as from a sacred vessel.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Thy nativity was glorious, thy life blameless, and thy departure honorable, O Baptizer of Christ.
Thy pointing to Christ was awesome, thy death was precious, and thy burial full of glory.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: As God, O Only-begotten One, thou didst abase Thyself,
that Thou mayest save those whom Thou hadst created,
for whose sake Thou didst become a man, incarnate of the Virgin;
and transforming my whole nature, Thou hast brought it to Thy Father.

ode3.katavasia:
The rod of Aaron is an image of this mystery,
for when it budded it showed who should be priest.
So in the Church, that once was barren,
the wood of the Cross hath now budded forth,
filling her with strength and steadfastness.

sedalenAfterOde3.text:
Having shone forth by the judgment of God from a barren woman,
and loosed the bonds on the tongue of thy father,
thou didst show forth the Sun Who illumineth thee as the morning-star,
and to the people in the wilderness didst proclaim the Creator,
the Lamb Who taketh away the sins of the world.
Wherefore, thou didst denounce the king with zeal, O ever-memorable and all-praised John,
and thy most glorious head was cut off.
Pray thou to Christ God, that He grant forgiveness of sins
unto those who with love celebrate thy holy memory.
sedalenAfterOde3.label: Sessional Hymn (after Ode 3)

bothNow.text:
All we, the generations of mankind, call thee blessed,
in that thou art the Virgin who alone among women
hast given birth without seed unto God in the flesh;
for the fire of the Godhead made its abode within thee,
and thou didst feed the Creator and Lord with milk as an infant.
Wherefore, we, the race of mankind and of angels,
glorify thy birthgiving, and together we cry out to thee:
Entreat Christ God to grant forgiveness of sins//
unto those who with faith worship thy most holy Offspring.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

ode4.irmos:
Thou, O Lord, art my strength and Thou art my power,
Thou art my God and Thou art my joy,
Thou Who, while never leaving the bosom of Thy Father, hast visited our poverty.
Therefore with the Prophet Habbakuk I cry unto Thee,
'Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!'
ode4.irmos2:
From the overshadowed mountain, from the only Theotokos,
the Prophet in divine vision foresaw Thy coming in the flesh, O Word,
and with fear he glorified Thy power.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
He who was unable to endure the censure of boldness and the forthrightness of piety,
who incurred the retribution of the law, who was depraved by vile pleasures,
having bound him who is enrolled immaterially in the heavenly choirs before the end,
placed him under guard.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The wretched voluptuary, sick with spiritually harmful drunkenness and the burning of fornication,
having been bound by the dancing of a young woman's feet,
becameth the murderer of the prophet;
for he conceived drunkenness, the mother of fornication, and begat grievous iniquity.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Thou art the boast of the faithful, O thou who knewest not wedlock;
thou art the intercessor and refuge of Christians, their bulwark and haven.
For thou bearest entreaties to thy Son, O all-immaculate one,
and savest from misfortunes those who with faith and love know thee to be the pure Theotokos.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Thou didst make clear to us the kingdom of Christ,
showing the people the paths of repentance,
and denouncing the iniquitous Herod, O wise John, thou great preacher.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Unable to bear reproof, Herod was overcome with wrath, jealousy and bitterness, O Baptist;
and he marked the day of his birth by cutting off thy head, O preacher of Christ.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Born of the immaculate Virgin Mother, O Thou Who hast put on my whole nature save for sin,
Thou didst preserve her pure even after she gaveth birth.

ode5.irmos:
O Light never-waning, why hast Thou turned Thy face from me
and why hath the alien darkness surrounded me, wretched though I be?
But do Thou guide my steps I implore Thee
and turn me back towards the light of Thy commandments.
ode5.irmos2:
Thou hast enlightened with the knowledge of God
the ends of the universe that lay in the night of ignorance,
do Thou also, O Lord, illumine me with the dawning of Thy love for mankind.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Inspired by the enmity of her mother, the yet more savage offspring of a savage lioness
demanded as the price of her foul demonic dancing
the head of the forerunner and herald, which the wild beasts themselves reverenced in the wilderness.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O Thine ineffable and unapproachable judgments, O Lover of mankind!
For the vile young woman won with her dancing him who, while yet in his mother's womb,
was a receptacle of the Holy Spirit, and who grew in chastity and purity.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
When he who with love and ardor preferred his intercourse with iniquity,
he permitted the murder of the prophet to be added to his birthday drinking
and with love of pleasure mingled a cup full of the holy blood of the prophet.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Possessing maternal boldness before thy Son, O most pure one,
disdain not the thought of kinship with us, we pray,
for thee alone do Christians set before the Master as a merciful cleansing.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The forerunner, the lamb of the wilderness and treasure of the whole world,
prepareth a spiritual banquet for us today.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O John, thou didst denounce Herod, the cruel lover of Herodias,
the slave of lust and violator of the laws.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Herodias danceth, and John is bound and slain.
O the drunkenness of Herod! O the mindlessness of his soul!

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Rejoice, O pure one, thou divine mountain from whence the stone was quarried
without the aid of the hands of men,
thou mountain of curds which provided God the Word with a body!

ode6.irmos2:
As Thou didst deliver the prophet from the depths of the abyss, O Christ God,
so deliver me also from my sins, O Lover of mankind,
and guide my life, I pray Thee.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Thy head, dripping with the blood of thy slaughter,
was offered as a prize for a lustful display,
but continued to denounce Herod as one who committed incest, even after thine end.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: May we be delivered from grievous transgressions through thy supplications, O pure Birthgiver of God,
and may we receive divine radiance from the Son of God
Who was ineffably incarnate from thee, O most pure one.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Honoring the decapitation of thine honored and most praised head, O forerunner of Christ,
we glorify thine ever-laudable and universal memory, O most blessed one.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O the vile feast! O the bitter birthday!
O the drunkenness of the abominable and iniquitous Herod!
For he was held fast by iniquity and, denounced, he was persuaded to slay the prophet.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The new Egyptian woman, dancing wantonly in the midst of the feast,
asked for the head which had denounced her mother, the paramour of Herod.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!

kontakion.text:
The glorious beheading of the forerunner
was part of God's dispensation,
that he might proclaim to those in Hades
the coming of the Savior.
Let Herodias, who demanded the iniquitous murder, therefore lament;
for she loved not the law of God nor the age of life,//
but rather this false and transitory one.
kontakion.label: Kontakion of the holy forerunner

ikos.text:
The birthday of Herod was shown to all to be unholy
when, into the midst of those who feasted,
the head of the faster was borne as though it were food.
Joy was joined to grief and laughter transformed into bitter lamentation.
For, bearing the head of the Baptist on a platter, the girl entered in among them all, as she said.
And because of Herod's oath lamentation fell upon all who reclined there with the king.
She did not gladden them, nor even Herod himself.
For he said: They sorrowed not with true grief, but with that which is feigned and transitory.

ode7.irmos2:
O Thou who in the beginning founded the earth
and by Thy word made the heavens firm,
blessed art Thou throughout the ages, O Lord God of our Fathers.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Armed with lustful desire and grievous drunkenness,
striking against the Baptizer of Christ, the immovable tower of abstinence
and indestructible city of chastity, the iniquitous Herod was shattered.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Her mind beguiled by the persuasions of her mother,
she who was the pupil of the devil was neither afraid nor ashamed,
nor in any way loath to bear thy precious head shamelessly on a platter.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Delivered from the ancient fall and condemnation by thy birth giving, O Virgin Mother,
we ever glorify thee as the manifest cause of our liberation,
with thy Son Who gaveth Himself as deliverance for us.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Preaching the law of God, John was not afraid to teach the impious and iniquitous Herod to be chaste;
for the fire of sin burned within him.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O the head which manifestly set forth the law and cried to Herod from out of the ground:
"It is not fit for thee, who committest iniquity,
to wear the purple robe of kingship as a garment of tyranny!"

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The iniquitous Herod, armed with vile weaponry,
committed an iniquitous deed with an oath,
drunk at the banquet he was holding for himself.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!

ode8.irmos2:
Glorified in the holy mountain,
the Lord revealed the mystery of the Ever-Virgin unto Moses
in the flames of the burning bush:
praise ye and supremely exalt Him throughout all ages.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
Going before Thy nativity and divine suffering, in the nethermost parts of the earth
John, as the voice of the Word, becometh, through the sword, the prophet and herald of Thy coming there,
crying: O ye dead, as Life-bestower, O ye blind, as the Giver of light,
O ye captives, as your Redeemer! Supremely exalt Christ throughout all ages.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
He who from a barren woman preceded the Offspring of the Virgin
hath now, through the cutting off of his head,
become the precursor of the voluntary crucifixion of the Creator of all,
crying to those in Hades: Ye children bless; ye priests hymn;
ye people supremely exalt Him throughout all ages!

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
When thy body was deprived of thy head, O forerunner,
thy masterly soul was parted from thy flesh;
but the divinity of Emmanuel was never separated from his flesh,
and not a bone of God the Master was broken.
Wherefore, we supremely exalt Him throughout all ages.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: O most pure Virgin, bearer of the Lord, by thy merciful supplication
cleanse thou the wounds and sores of my soul, and raise me up who am fallen.
Save, O save me, the prodigal, O all-immaculate one!
For thou art mine intercessor and help, who alone art pure and blessed throughout all ages.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
Him who proclaimed the coming of Christ to those in Hades,
exclaiming with faith: "The Lord of glory cometh, loosing men's pangs!"
let us supremely exalt throughout all ages.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
Herod imprisoned thee in a dungeon, O John, thou second Elijah,
and, having bound thee with iron chains, slew thee,
the faithful and sacred proclaimer of repentance and the kingdom.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless, and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text:
O feast full of blood! O food mingled with murder!
O banquet replete with vainglory!
O the inhumanity and vile murder of the iniquitous Herod!

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Wholly above and wholly below,
in the bosom of the Father and with Thy Mother,
wholly God and wholly man by nature, of One Hypostasis yet dual in nature art Thou, O Merciful One.

ode9.irmos2:
The prophetic vision of the lawgiver on the mountain,
in the fire of the burning bush, prefigured thy birthgiving O Ever-Virgin,
the salvation of us the faithful,
wherefore with never silent hymns we magnify thee.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
The evil horde and the devil, its commander, were afraid of thy divinely eloquent tongue
which proclaimed Christ, O prophet,
and through the agency of a wanton young woman prevailed upon Herod to cut off thy head;
but we magnify thee as the baptizer of Christ.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Human passions tremble, and the demons flee in fear from the overshadowing of the grace given thee by God.
But deliver thy flock, which ever magnifieth thee with faith,
O forerunner of the Lord, from temptation by both.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text:
Theotokion: Draw Thy bow, and prosper and reign, O Son of the Mother of God,
subduing all heresies and granting victory to our Orthodox hierarchs,
through the entreaties of her who gaveth birth to Thee, O Word of God.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Again doth Jezebel exult over Elijah; again doth the Egyptian woman seek after Joseph;
for the vile Herodias hath now been seen to devise the death of the prophet and baptizer of the Savior.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
Beheaded by Herod, O John, thou wast sent to the souls in Hades,
to proclaim Him Who had come to save all of the faithful who had reposed, from the time of Adam on.

troparia.refrain: Holy Forerunner of the Lord, pray to God for us!
troparia.text:
O John, honored martyr of the Lord, lamp-stand of the Light, voice of the Word,
herald of the Lamb of God, lamb of the wilderness:
pray that those who hymn thee be saved.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!

exapostilaria.label: Exaposteilarion of the holy forerunner

exapostilaria.text:
The vile Herod was unable to cut off the reproofs of thy tongue, O baptizer of the Savior,
and therefore deceitfully cut off the head of thee, the husbandman of purity.
exapostilaria.label: Another Exaposteilarion (at Glory)

exapostilaria.text:
Having destroyed the curse on the world by thy divine birthgiving, O pure Maiden,
through thy supplications, deliver from all misfortunes
the flock which entreateth thee with faith.
exapostilaria.label: Theotokion (at Both now)

stichera.verse: To do among them the judgment that is written: this glory shall be to all His saints. (Ps. 149:9)
stichera.text:
O most glorious wonder!
the impure wanton young woman hath borne to her adulterous mother
the sacred head, which even the angels reverence,
and which denounced her iniquitous acts.
O thine ineffable patience, O Lover of mankind,
whereby, save Thou our souls, O Christ,//
in that Thou alone art full of tender compassion.

stichera.verse: Praise God in His saints; praise Him in the firmament of His power. (Ps. 150:1)
Praise Him for His mighty deeds; praise Him according to His exceeding greatness. (Ps. 150:2)
stichera.text:
O the hardness of Herod's heart!
He who dishonored God by violating His laws
displayeth his hypocrisy by deceitfully keeping his oath
and joineth murder to adultery, feigning regret.
O Thine unspeakable loving-kindness, O Master,
whereby save Thou our souls, O Christ,//
in that Thou alone art compassionate!

stichera.verse: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet; praise Him with the psaltery and harp. (Ps. 150:3)
stichera.text:
O marvel past understanding!
The seal of the prophets, the earthly angel, is shown to be
the price of wanton dancing;
the tongue of theology is sent forth as herald of Christ to those in Hades.
O Thine ineffable providence, O Master,
whereby save Thou our souls, O Christ,//
in that Thou alone art compassionate!

doxastikon.text:
Again Herodias rageth insanely, again is she vexed.
O what deceitful dancing, what a feast of deception!
The Baptist is beheaded, and Herod is troubled.
Through the supplications of Thy forerunner, O Lord,//
grant peace to our souls.

theotokion.text:
O Theotokos, thou art the true vine
that hast budded forth for us the Fruit of life.
Thee do we entreat:
Pray thou, O Lady, with the holy apostles,//
that He have mercy upon our souls.
theotokion.label: Theotokion at Both now

troparionAfterDoxology.text:
The memory of the just is celebrated with hymns of praise
but the Lord's testimony is enough for thee, O Forerunner,
for thou wast shown to be more wonderful than the Prophets
since thou wast granted to baptize in the running waters
Him Whom thou didst proclaim.
Then having endured great suffering for the Truth,
Thou didst rejoice to bring, even to those in Hades
the good tidings that God had appeared in the flesh
taking away the sin of the world//
and granting us great mercy.
